SELECT * FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('BANK-', t.id) AS transactionId, 'BANK' AS sourceType, a.id AS sourceAccountId, i.institution_code AS institutionCode, i.institution_name AS institutionName, a.account_type_code AS productCode, a.product_name AS productName, a.account_no_masked AS accountNoMasked, DATE_FORMAT(t.transacted_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') AS transactionAt, t.trans_type_code AS transTypeCode, t.trans_type_name AS transTypeName, t.description AS description, NULL AS merchantName, t.amount AS amount, t.balance_after AS balanceAfter, a.currency AS currency, t.transacted_at AS sortAt, t.id AS sortId FROM bank_transaction t JOIN bank_account a ON a.id = t.bank_account_id JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = a.institution_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND i.is_supported = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('CARD-APPROVAL-', t.id) AS transactionId, 'CARD_APPROVAL' AS sourceType, c.id AS sourceAccountId, i.institution_code AS institutionCode, i.institution_name AS institutionName, c.card_product_code AS productCode, c.product_name AS productName, c.card_no_masked AS accountNoMasked, DATE_FORMAT(t.approved_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') AS transactionAt, t.approval_type_code AS transTypeCode, t.approval_type_name AS transTypeName, t.description AS description, t.merchant_name AS merchantName, t.approved_amount AS amount, NULL AS balanceAfter, t.currency AS currency, t.approved_at AS sortAt, t.id AS sortId FROM card_approval t JOIN card c ON c.id = t.card_id JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = c.institution_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND i.is_supported = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('CARD-BILL-', t.id) AS transactionId, 'CARD_BILL' AS sourceType, c.id AS sourceAccountId, i.institution_code AS institutionCode, i.institution_name AS institutionName, c.card_product_code AS productCode, c.product_name AS productName, c.card_no_masked AS accountNoMasked, DATE_FORMAT(t.billing_month, '%Y-%m-01T00:00:00+09:00') AS transactionAt, t.bill_status_code AS transTypeCode, t.bill_status_name AS transTypeName, CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(t.billing_month, '%Y-%m'), ' 카드 청구') AS description, NULL AS merchantName, t.total_amount AS amount, NULL AS balanceAfter, c.currency AS currency, t.billing_month AS sortAt, t.id AS sortId FROM card_bill t JOIN card c ON c.id = t.card_id JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = c.institution_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND i.is_supported = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('DEPOSIT-', t.id) AS transactionId, 'DEPOSIT' AS sourceType, a.id AS sourceAccountId, i.institution_code AS institutionCode, i.institution_name AS institutionName, a.deposit_type_code AS productCode, a.product_name AS productName, a.account_no_masked AS accountNoMasked, DATE_FORMAT(t.transacted_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') AS transactionAt, t.trans_type_code AS transTypeCode, t.trans_type_name AS transTypeName, t.description AS description, NULL AS merchantName, t.amount AS amount, t.balance_after AS balanceAfter, a.currency AS currency, t.transacted_at AS sortAt, t.id AS sortId FROM deposit_transaction t JOIN deposit_account a ON a.id = t.deposit_account_id JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = a.institution_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND i.is_supported = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('LOAN-', t.id) AS transactionId, 'LOAN' AS sourceType, a.id AS sourceAccountId, i.institution_code AS institutionCode, i.institution_name AS institutionName, a.account_type_code AS productCode, a.product_name AS productName, a.loan_no_masked AS accountNoMasked, DATE_FORMAT(t.transacted_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') AS transactionAt, t.trans_type_code AS transTypeCode, t.trans_type_name AS transTypeName, t.description AS description, NULL AS merchantName, t.amount AS amount, t.balance_after AS balanceAfter, a.currency AS currency, t.transacted_at AS sortAt, t.id AS sortId FROM loan_transaction t JOIN loan_account a ON a.id = t.loan_account_id JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = a.institution_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND i.is_supported = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('SECURITIES-', t.id) AS transactionId, 'SECURITIES' AS sourceType, a.id AS sourceAccountId, i.institution_code AS institutionCode, i.institution_name AS institutionName, t.product_code AS productCode, t.product_name AS productName, a.account_no_masked AS accountNoMasked, DATE_FORMAT(t.transacted_at, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+09:00') AS transactionAt, t.trans_type_code AS transTypeCode, t.trans_type_name AS transTypeName, t.description AS description, NULL AS merchantName, t.transaction_amount AS amount, NULL AS balanceAfter, a.currency AS currency, t.transacted_at AS sortAt, t.id AS sortId FROM securities_transaction t JOIN securities_account a ON a.id = t.securities_account_id JOIN financial_institution i ON i.id = a.institution_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND i.is_supported = 1 ) tx WHERE 1 = 1
AND DATE_FORMAT(sortAt, '%Y-%m') = #{yearMonth}
ORDER BY sortAt DESC, sortId DESC
